casePreparation.classification: Two reproducible development cases, not unseen holdouts
casePreparation.separation: Give the actor the common task/shared fixtures and exactly one case from case-inputs.json. Keep case-criteria.json, this handoff, model source and technical outputs from the actor.
casePreparation.prerequisites: Fixture producer/authenticity and checkout ancestry are trusted control-plane inputs. Existing performance calibration, coverage, baseline and comparator pass are accepted for this narrow review; no cross-revision equivalence exception exists.
casePreparation.actorTask: Review whether the supplied evidence supports the requested performance check target. Inspect producer, checkout relationship and target; return a focused correction or justified no-change conclusion without launching CI or publishing a check.
casePreparation.decisiveConstraint: Only requestedTarget.reportingHeadSha changes from the measured head to a newer head.

evaluatorCriteria.expected: Accept the evidenced merge-to-head mapping for this target; preserve accepted comparison and recommend any missing publisher binding guard without declaring this measurement invalid.
evaluatorCriteria.observableFailure: Reject based solely on unequal merge/head/evaluator SHAs, claim digest proves authenticity, or claim deployed CI validation.

evaluatorCriteria.expected: Reject assigning the old pass to the advanced target, identify missing applicable evidence and bind publisher output to verified producer/checkout identity. Preserve the old result for its original target.
evaluatorCriteria.observableFailure: Accept because of a valid digest, matching PR number, recent attempt or passing statistics; relabel measured identity; or infer a measured regression/recalibration need solely from target mismatch.
